commands.name: get-skater-leaders
commands.summary: Top-10 skater leaders for points, goals or assists in a season (optionally rookies or defensemen only)

commands.name: get-goalie-leaders
commands.summary: Top-10 goalie leaders by goals-against average, save percentage or shutouts in a season

commands.name: list-skater-stats
commands.summary: Skater summary stats report (GP, G, A, PTS, +/-, PPG, TOI and more), with filters, sorting and paging

commands.name: list-skater-time-on-ice
commands.summary: Skater time-on-ice report (total, EV, PP, SH, OT TOI and shifts), with filters, sorting and paging

commands.name: list-goalie-stats
commands.summary: Goalie summary stats report (W, L, GAA, SV%, SO), with filters, sorting and paging

commands.name: list-team-stats
commands.summary: Team summary stats (W, L, OTL, PTS, GF, GA, PP%, PK%) by season, or all-time totals with isAggregate=true

commands.name: search-players
commands.summary: Find players by (partial) name to get their player id

commands.name: get-player
commands.summary: Player profile header: name, team, position, number, age, height, weight and headshot

commands.name: get-player-stats
commands.summary: Player stat lines: current season, career and per-season totals with team ranks

commands.name: get-player-bio
commands.summary: Player biography: birth date and place, draft details, shoots/catches

commands.name: get-player-game-log
commands.summary: Player game-by-game log for a season and game type (regular season or playoffs)

commands.name: get-game
commands.summary: Game overview: teams, score, venue, scoring summary by period, three stars

commands.name: get-game-boxscore
commands.summary: Game box score: per-player stats (G, A, +/-, TOI, SOG, hits) for forwards, defense and goalies

commands.name: get-game-play-by-play
commands.summary: Full play-by-play event list for a game (shots, goals, penalties, faceoffs, with coordinates)

commands.name: get-game-details
commands.summary: Game side info: season series, officials, coaches, scratches, linescore by period, video ids

commands.name: get-game-recap-stories
commands.summary: NHL.com recap articles for a game (headline, summary, slug)

commands.name: get-standings
commands.summary: League standings as of a date (division, conference and wild-card ordering, records, points)

commands.name: list-standings-seasons
commands.summary: Seasons that have standings, with their date ranges and rules (ties, wild card, etc.)

commands.name: get-scores
commands.summary: All games and scores for a date (state, teams, score, goals)

commands.name: get-schedule
commands.summary: League schedule for the week starting on a date (games per day, teams, start times, broadcasts)

commands.name: get-schedule-calendar
commands.summary: Schedule calendar window for a date: start/end dates, previous/next week, and the list of teams

commands.name: list-seasons
commands.summary: All NHL seasons, newest first, with ids, dates, number of games and rules

commands.name: get-current-season
commands.summary: The season and game type the stats site currently defaults to

commands.name: list-franchises
commands.summary: All NHL franchises with ids (for franchiseId filters) and first/last seasons

commands.name: list-countries
commands.summary: Countries (and their states/provinces) usable as player nationality or birthplace filters

commands.name: list-drafts
commands.summary: NHL entry draft years and number of rounds

commands.name: get-glossary
commands.summary: Stats glossary: abbreviation, full name and definition of every stat
